title: AndroidAPS 3.2 dev hangs after pressing NSClientV3 "switch on" button
body:
Version 3.2.0-dev-m
Build 90e23b4f78-2023. 10.18
Wanted to activate sending data to Nightscout. The option in the Configurator for NSClient can be switched on like normal, but the new NSClientV3 option makes AndroidAPS hang. 
Button turns gray, showing it is selected, but after that nothing happens anymore and the app hangs.
See screenshot.

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/13044045/AndroidAPS.log)
![Screenshot_20231019_163209_info nightscout androidaps](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76550379/a159f07b-0a65-4d5d-bfdd-9a1a69df5b04)

comments.body:
I experienced the same some other day. Not sure how exactly but i made it work again. I think installing rc2 and update to dev again may have helped. Not that it makes any sense 😅 

https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/2929

just restart the app helps
it's android issue

Tried restarting the app, but didn't help.
Tried stopping the app and deleting cache data did not help.
Restarting phone didn't help either.
Same problem here on a google pixel 5 with Android 14.

Happened under different circumstances.
-  With activated NsCV1 and trying to activate V3
-  With restart of app
- With cleared data and cache data

And i am not be able to activate NSCv3 either.
Every time app freezes and if the timout occures android ask 'wait' or close app.
Only thing i can do is to close the app. After restart NsV3 is not activated.

> is after restart NSCv3 activated?

Same as osodebailar.
After restart NSCv3 is not activated.

FYI: Can not repro this problem on my test phone (running Android 12)

Running current dev-m, commit b18f3c9e
Had already NSCv3 active.
Deactivating v3, activating v1, switching back to v3 was no problem.

**Edit**: Tested on main phone (S22 Ultra) running Android 13, same build: OK, no problems.

Thank you Milos,
With this update the problem is solved.
Thank you very much for all your work on AndroidAPS!
You help is all a lot, to have a beter life, with better control and less risk of diabetic complications.

Best regards, 
Bas Geurds
